records.en: An exquisite ring made of pure gold. Give it to a family member to increase their Intimacy by 1.
A ring inlaid with jewels. Give it to a family member to increase their Intimacy by 2.
A romantic necklace made of flowers. Give it to a family member to increase their Blessing Power by 1.
Elegant Jewel Necklace. Give it to a family member to increase their Blessing Power by 2.
A luxurious ring inlaid with diamonds. Give it to a family member to increase their Intimacy by 5.
◆ Give gifts to family members to improve your Intimacy with them as well as their Blessing Power.
◆ Skills that increase Building Earnings and Fellow Attributes.
◆ Upgrading family relationships improves Pupil Intellect as well as the effects of the relationship.

◆ Dates with family members are divided into Sailing Trip and Airship Journey. Sailing Trip costs Crystals, grants a large amount of Blessing Points, and guarantees 1 child. Airship Journey costs Perfume, grants a large amount of Blessing Points, and guarantees a twin.
◆ Spend Energy to go on a random date with a random family member.
◆ Going on a random date with a family member awards Blessing Points based on the family member's Blessing Power.
◆ This represents the intimacy that exists in a Transcender's family relationships. The higher the Intimacy, the greater Pupil Earnings will be.
◆ Energy recovers over time. The higher the protagonist's Rank, the higher the Energy limit will be. Items can also be used to increase Energy.
◆ This represents the strength of the blessings that a family member can provide. The higher their Blessing Power, the more Blessing Points they will receive after dates.
